# Security and Validation Checklist: Cadastro de Usuário pelo Administrativo

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade, clareza, consistência e cobertura dos requisitos de autorização, validação e integridade do cadastro de usuários.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Autorização e Controle de Acesso

- [x] CHK001 Are the requirements that restrict user creation to the Administrativo profile complete and testable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is the behavior defined when a non-Administrativo accesses the creation route directly? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified that Coordenador, Aluno e CPA Externo não devem ver a opção de cadastro? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK004 Are authorization requirements consistent between a visibilidade na interface e a guarda de acesso? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]

## Validação e Integridade dos Dados

- [x] CHK005 Are the mandatory fields (nome, e-mail, senha e cargo) explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is the minimum password length quantified with a specific value? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK007 Is e-mail uniqueness defined, incluindo normalização de maiúsculas e espaços? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 Are CPF optionality and the 11-digit rule unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Is the behavior defined when CPF is provided with formatting (pontos e traço)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Is it specified that a newly created user is always active? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK011 Is the all-or-nothing behavior on partial failure specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are duplicate-e-mail handling requirements complete, including mensagem e não criação? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Cargos e Vínculos

- [x] CHK013 Is the "at least one cargo" rule quantified and testable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK014 Is it explicit whether multiple cargos may be selected? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK015 Are the allowed cargo values enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK016 Is the requirement that Aluno needs a curso specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK017 Is the relationship between a user and their cargos defined consistently with the data model? [Consistency, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK018 Is creating another Administrativo explicitly allowed or excluded? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Fluxos de Erro e Casos de Borda

- [x] CHK019 Are error messages defined for each validation failure? [Completeness, Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK020 Are the success confirmation and the list update defined after creation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK021 Is the login of a newly created user with the provided credentials specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK022 Are concurrent creation attempts with the same e-mail addressed? [Coverage, Gap]

## Segurança e Privacidade

- [x] CHK023 Is password handling specified so the value is not exposed after creation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK024 Are CPF protection requirements, as personal data, specified? [Gap]
- [x] CHK025 Are the access-control requirements consistent with the constitution and the existing system? [Consistency]

## Rastreabilidade e Consistência

- [x] CHK026 Does every functional requirement have identifiable acceptance criteria? [Traceability]
- [x] CHK027 Is the terminology "cargo" and "perfil" used consistently across spec and plan? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK028 Is the assumption about available cargos validated against the data model? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
